## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T04:39Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 440158845c46c8fa9db9159c0300543d14ddf75b
Card: #34603 · claim 6937462744 · os-dev-report 6938162064

The code change is right and the premise correction holds (readings below). One published doc is made false by this PR, so it cannot land as is.

### Must-fix

1. **`content/docs/ui/views.mdx` § "Switching views" (lines 402–404 at this head) now states the removed behaviour.** It says the switcher reads the view's label and a ▾, "and on a grid the number of records the view holds", with the example **Leads / My Leads ▾ · 12**. After this PR the title is `Leads / My Leads ▾` with no number, so the published page is false. Checklist rule: a published defect this round makes false is fixed in the same PR. Fix: drop the count clause and the `· 12` from the example, and if useful say the count is in the list's footer. A `grep -nE "▾ · |number of records the view holds" content skills` at this head finds only these two lines, so nothing else in docs or `skills/**` needs the edit.
   - `content/docs/**` is outside the claim's file surface (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/**`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/**`, `ui/e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts`, root `.changeset/`). The claim's file surface must be amended to add `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` in the same round, and the PR body must name the amendment.

### Should-fix (same round, cheap)

2. Source comments this PR makes false, all in the claim's surface:
   - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx:36` and `:133`: 「OBJECT / VIEW ▾ · COUNT」.
   - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:1208`: 「<view> ▾ · N」.
   - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950.test.tsx:15` (header comment): 「OBJECT / VIEW ▾ · COUNT」.
   Found with `git grep -nE "▾ · |VIEW ▾ · COUNT" ui` at this head. The two files the PR edited were updated; these four lines were missed.

### Readings that hold (no change needed)

| Item | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34603`; no other closing verb in the body (`#27594` stands verb-free). No `!`, no `(narrowing)`: no dogfood battery owed. |
| Scope | 7 files, all inside the claim surface except the must-fix above (which is missing, not extra). No plugin-list change, as the report says. |
| Published surface (your point 1) | Verified. `ui/packages/app-shell/package.json` has `"private": true`; its single `.` export is `dist/index.js`, and `src/index.ts` re-exports from `./views/index.js` only `ObjectView, RecordDetailView, RecordFormPage, DashboardView, PageView, ReportView, SearchResultsPage, ViewConfigPanel, DeclaredActionsBar, FlowRunner` plus their types. `ObjectViewTitleSwitcher` / `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` / `count` / `viewTotal` are not exported. Nothing published narrows; `Clause-②: no` is right. `ListView`'s own `onTotalChange` (published, `@object-ui/plugin-list`) is untouched; it is only no longer passed here, and the `page:tabs` badge still uses it (`plugin-list/README.md` § "The tab badge"). `useDisplayLocale` is still used at `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx:457`, so the import stays live. |
| Changeset | Names `@object-ui/app-shell` (private, versioned per `privatePackages.version: true`; 26 recent changesets name it) and `@object-ui/console` (not private, the shipping package). Sentences read against the diff: 「VIEW ▾ · COUNT」 → 「VIEW ▾」 "on every width" (span and `count` prop removed, desktop and phone tests pin it); "count still shown in the list's footer, on a phone too" (see next row); "footer's count and summaries unchanged" (no plugin-list hunk). True. |
| Premise correction, acceptance 2 (your point 2) | Verified at this head. `ListViewCompactHeader` is drawn only under `compactPosture` (`plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:6491–6497`, objectui#12703); the footer `record-count-bar` (`ListView.tsx:7794–7797`) is gated on `listChromeShown && (recordCountShown \|\| …)` with classes `border-t px-4 py-2 flex …`, no `max-sm:hidden` / `hidden` / `sm:flex`. The 27594 test pins the phone (390 px) footer reading 「1 record」 outside `list-toolbar-leading`. The card's "footer hidden on phone" did not hold; the correction is stated in the PR body. Acceptance 2 is met with the footer as the phone's one count. |
| Acceptance 1 / 3 | Met: desktop title reads `View 1` only (`/^View 1$/` on the switcher's outer span); `objectViewTitleSwitcher.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594.test.tsx` and `e2e/list-toolbar-view-name-phone.spec.ts` all updated as the card names. |
| Removed CONTROL | `CONTROL: no count is drawn until the list reports one` is deleted; with no `count` prop left it has nothing to control, and the new title test asserts the absence directly. Fine. |
| `import '@objectstack/lint'` in the 27594 test | `@objectstack/lint` is an app-shell dependency (`package.json:96`); asked by `check:test-source-alias` for an edited test reaching `ObjectView`'s dynamic import. In surface, justified. |
| Tests | Real commands with output; ablation re-inserts the span and turns the 3 new assertions red (3 failed / 19 passed), restored to the HEAD blob. |
| Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34634`: NOT governed, 0 of 7 paths, 98 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-C after the fix. |
| CI on this head | 51 check-runs: 38 `success`, 13 `skipped`, none failing or pending. |
| Deviations (your point 3) | Plain-text signature line and model-free trailers: no action. |

### Notes

- Real-browser visual check NOT MEASURED (declared). Acceptable for an S card.
- After the fix push, send the new head: I owe a delta read (docs sentence + comment lines + the claim amendment), not a full re-review.

Round note 6939253561 names both on the PR in the meantime. The landing area should see the body updated, or the seat's ruling that the comment suffices, before the merge.
